# function: schedule_analyze

Analyzes a job schedule and returns the next runtimes as a JSON-encoded array of {timestamp, utc} objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# pve_schedule_analyze — see docs/functions/schedule_analyze.md
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
schedule_analyze(schedule string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `schedule` (String) Job schedule. The format is a subset of `systemd` calendar events.
